comparison.objective: Use a wall-pivoted tong to move a vial from a rack into a close-fitting holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sprung-jaw control and reversed-motion tool steering through a gimbal.
comparison.success_condition: Vial reaches a holder only 1 cm wider while jaws remain controlled; release, stability, and damage thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual tool control, but this tests indirect reversed kinematics and vial insertion rather than impact fracture and tang containment.
